context: Published-origin page gate as the release condition (rollout Phase C step 4 / delivery-gates.md § Gate 8), hands-off, offline. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: report_read_not_rejudged
checklist.description: The publish decision is taken from stardust/rollout/gate-report.json (or the delivery.gate blocks copied from it) — the agent quotes the report's statuses and numbers (pass / fail 12.4 % Δh −112 / unmeasured exit 124 / ungated / published-failing 23.2 %) and never derives a verdict by reading a screenshot, a prototype number or progress.json's prototype-regime numbers as if they were the page gate.

checklist.name: publish_holds_non_pass_rows
checklist.description: The publish step is deploy-batch.mjs … --publish --plan (or an equivalent offline reading of the report). Exactly two rows are named publishable (/ and /business); /insurance/auto, /news/storm-season-checklist and /insurance/home are held with the report's reason class (FAIL / unmeasured / ungated). A run that publishes, or declares publishable, any held row fails this item.

checklist.name: template_not_at_bar_not_published
checklist.description: The coverage regime is applied per template: program (one FAIL, one ungated) and article (one unmeasured, one published-failing) are named as not at the bar and none of their rows is published or declared publishable; landing (both PASS) is the only template at the bar. The agent does not call a template 'at the bar' or 'gated' because its archetype's prototype-regime number passes.

checklist.name: no_live_call_no_escape_flags
checklist.description: No POST /live/ is issued or claimed (the .example origin has no admin API); --publish-ungated and --publish-no-regression are not passed and not proposed as the hands-off way forward (they are operator/owner flags, D16); no --bar / threshold flag or edit appears; the FAIL page is not described as a documented or accepted residual.

checklist.name: published_failing_reported_not_unpublished
checklist.description: /news/annual-report-2025 is reported as published-failing (already live, 1440 FAIL) — never unpublished, never re-published, never counted as PASS or verified; the report names it as an owner decision (fix round + re-gate, or accept a named-class residual).

checklist.name: gate_table_then_coverage_line
checklist.description: The report opens with the gate table (one row per page: path, status, per-breakpoint number, at, regime published-origin) before any counts or prose, then prints the coverage line with counts equal to the report's coverage{} — published-gated 4 of 6 · PASS 2 · FAIL 1 · unmeasured 1 · ungated 1 · published-failing 1 (a held count of 3 may follow). Any verified count quotes only PASS rows.

checklist.name: unmeasured_is_redrive_not_fail
checklist.description: The exit-124 page (/news/storm-season-checklist) is called unmeasured (no verdict) with the re-drive — gate-publish.mjs --paths … --origin <preview> — never a FAIL, never a pass, never folded into the failed count.

checklist.name: handsoff_blocked_at_preview
checklist.description: Under handsOff the run ends blocked at preview: a status.jsonl blocked line whose next is the exact re-drive (re-gate the unmeasured/ungated pages, fix round for the FAIL page, then the same --publish run), no question to the user, no 'ready for review' / 'published' claim while rows are held.

checklist.name: read_only_inputs
checklist.description: stardust/migrated/**, stardust/replica/**, stardust/rollout/gate-report.json and content/.deploy-ledger.json are byte-identical to the fixture after the run; writes land only under stardust/rollout/ (coverage roll-ups), stardust/.work/, an appended journal.md entry and status.jsonl lines, plus the master Setup's own housekeeping.
